them.zh: Monid 的编译器和引擎做的

steps.en: Describe the vendor API declaratively: auth, request, input schema, usage model
steps.zh: 用声明式写法描述厂商 API：鉴权、请求、输入 schema、计费模型

steps.en: Record one real response as a fixture, then pass the replay tests offline
steps.zh: 录一份真实响应当 fixture，再离线跑通回放测试
steps.code: deno task record · deno task test

steps.en: Compiles every definition into flat JSON docs with hash-referenced functions
steps.zh: 把所有定义编译成扁平 JSON 文档，函数按内容哈希引用

steps.en: Run one endpoint with your own vendor key exported in the environment
steps.zh: 把自己的厂商 key 放进环境变量，跑一个端点

steps.en: Validates the input, builds the request and injects the key inside the transport
steps.zh: 校验输入、构造请求，在传输层内部注入 key

steps.en: Settles usage on the raw response, then maps and validates the output
steps.zh: 先在原始响应上结算用量，再映射并校验输出

value.en: Every vendor API is called through one declared contract — same validation, metering and error shape — instead of one hand-written client per vendor
value.zh: 每家厂商 API 都走同一份声明好的契约——校验、计量、错误形态一致——不用再给每家手写一个客户端

sources: https://github.com/monid-ai/monid README 'The shape' (defineProvider / defineEndpoint, connectors/tinyfish/), 'Quickstart' (deno task check && deno task test; export TINYFISH_CREDENTIALS_API_KEY; deno task engine:run 'tinyfish#search' --query-params ...), steps 1-5 (deno task record)

DEVELOPMENT.md 'Concepts: defs → docs → bundle → sealed unit', 'Compiler', 'Engine' pipeline (validate input → toRequest → transport.execute with credential injection → usage.consolidate on raw envelope → fromResponse → validate output), CLI reference
scripts/run.ts header (JIT compile, sealUnit, Engine.load with directTransport, credentials from env)
